held.headline: Universal Amphitheater: 5 Shows Before It Was Demolished
held.reason: fact-checker: "Between those two sat Siouxsie and the Banshees and the Brian Setzer Orchestra, just two other artists filling out five visits to the same room." (contradicted) — Universal Amphitheater's full show list includes Tears For Fears on 1993-11-04, which falls between the 1989 Howard Jones show and the 2005 Tears For Fears show — so three shows, not two artists, filled the middle.
